_readme: TEMPLATE. Copy to <workdir>/protocol.json and edit every section.
The pipeline code is generic; this file is the whole review-specific part.
Codes are validated so that a code's first letter must equal its family key,
because the pipeline derives the family from the `d` field everywhere.

review.title: EXAMPLE: <exposure> and the risk of <outcome>
review.notes: Title/abstract stage never decides Include. F/M codes are the Hold pool.

code_meanings.F1: Abstract explicitly reports the outcome of interest
code_meanings.F2: Multi-site / all-cancer cohort (target outcome may sit in a supplement)
code_meanings.F3: No exclusion criterion applies but key information is missing
code_meanings.M1: Mendelian randomisation / genetic study -> parallel triangulation stream
code_meanings.X1: No exposure wording anywhere in the title/abstract
code_meanings.X2: Outcome is a single non-target cancer
code_meanings.X3: No cancer-incidence outcome (prognosis / diagnosis / treatment / mechanism)
code_meanings.X4: Case report, case series n<10, animal or in-vitro study
code_meanings.X5: No comparison group / cross-sectional / no temporal order
code_meanings.R1: Review, editorial, comment or letter with no original data of its own

normalize_rules.description: Systematic review / meta-analysis has no original data of its own -> R1. Definitional, therefore safe to apply automatically.

audit_exports.name: boundary_audit
audit_exports.description: Records sitting on an ambiguous code boundary. Both codes exclude, so only the PRISMA reason split moves -> export for humans, never auto-fix.
